contract_source.expected_solution: Envoy v1.28.0 implements its xDS client under source/extensions/config_subscription/grpc/ (the config_subscription extension tree, where this code moved from source/common/config in earlier releases): grpc_subscription_impl.cc defines GrpcSubscriptionImpl, which layers per-type subscription bookkeeping on a shared GrpcMux that owns the ADS stream, resource type URL bookkeeping, and version/nonce acking. source/common/config/subscription_base.h provides the SubscriptionBase template that typed config consumers derive from for resource decoding.
evaluation_criteria: Cites grpc_subscription_impl.cc under the config_subscription extension tree at v1.28.0
Names GrpcSubscriptionImpl and the GrpcMux it delegates the shared ADS stream to
Cites subscription_base.h as the typed subscription base

direct_consumers.expected_solution: Istio 1.20.0 serves xDS from pilot/pkg/xds: ads.go implements the state-of-the-world DiscoveryStream handling for CDS/EDS/LDS/RDS pushes and delta.go the incremental variant. go-control-plane v0.12.0 provides the reference server in pkg/server/v3 (server.go, the ADS stream handler) backed by versioned resource snapshots from pkg/cache/v3 (snapshot.go, NewSnapshot/Consistent/GetVersion).
evaluation_criteria: Cites pilot/pkg/xds/ads.go and pilot/pkg/xds/delta.go for Istio pilot's xDS server
Cites pkg/server/v3/server.go for go-control-plane's ADS stream handler
Cites pkg/cache/v3/snapshot.go for the versioned snapshot cache

transitive_impact.expected_solution: All three implementations meet on the ADS RPC StreamAggregatedResources (and its incremental twin DeltaAggregatedResources). The divergence surface is version/nonce bookkeeping: Istio's ads.go decides whether to respond by comparing the request's ResponseNonce against the last nonce it sent and inspecting VersionInfo; go-control-plane tracks per-type snapshot versions handed out by pkg/cache/v3; Envoy's GrpcMux acks with the VersionInfo/nonce pair it last accepted. Mismatched expectations in that handshake — a stale ResponseNonce after reconnect, per-type versus per-snapshot VersionInfo semantics — are what reject pushes and surface as intermittent 503s during config updates.
evaluation_criteria: Names StreamAggregatedResources / DeltaAggregatedResources as the shared ADS contract surface
Traces the ResponseNonce comparison in Istio pilot's should-respond logic
Explains the VersionInfo handling divergence across the three implementations
